notes.title: [v0.1.2]
notes.content:
[Critical Bugs]

 Win even if there were still enemy kingdoms
 Random enemy units spawn within my territory
 Not registering win
 Not merging provinces correctly
 Enemy kingdom can attack land defended by unit
 The economy values ​​change depending on whether you click in your territory or not. Sometimes it seems random
 Bugs merging units
 You can select enemy units and make them yours. After that, they're yours forever, but they're bugged
 Not dividing kingdoms into provinces
 Attacking an enemy land that has a unit, also merge the units on both lands



[Bugs]

 Fix scoreboard - take into account all kingdom's provinces



Please report any bugs and features ideas on the following channels:
- Discord
- Community Hub
